Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/stb && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
import subprocess, itertools
img=Image.new('RGB',(32,32),(1,2,3))
img.save('/tmp/base.jpg','JPEG',subsampling=0,quality=90)
base=bytearray(Path('/tmp/base.jpg').read_bytes())
idx=base.find(b'\xff\xc0')
cs=idx+2+2+1+2+2+1
# brute force a broader set of malformed sampling bytes for all 3 components.
vals=[0x11,0x12,0x13,0x14,0x21,0x22,0x23,0x24,0x31,0x32,0x33,0x34,0x41,0x42,0x43,0x44]
interesting=[]
for a,b,c in itertools.product(vals, repeat=3):
    data=bytearray(base)
    data[cs+1]=a; data[cs+4]=b; data[cs+7]=c
    p='/tmp/t.jpg'
    Path(p).write_bytes(data)
    r=subprocess.run(['/tmp/jpeg_poc',p],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if r.returncode!=0:
        interesting.append((a,b,c,r.returncode,r.stderr.splitlines()[:4]))
        if len(interesting)>=12:
            break
print('interesting',interesting)
